name: zreader_read_named_float
description: zReader::ReadNamedFloat reads a named direct or array-wrapped float/int node, converts integer payloads to float, and leaves the output unchanged on failure.
known_limits: No isolated VC COFF byte comparison is recorded; tier S verification is deferred to the coherent zReader lookup/parser source-cluster pass.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly for 0x48cfb0 validates zReader::GetNamedNode lookup, direct FLOAT bit-copy, direct INT fild/fstp conversion, array-wrapped FLOAT bit-copy, array-wrapped INT fild/fstp conversion, success return 1, and failure return 0 without writing outValue.

The native zreader_named_string_float_lookup_smoke covers direct float, direct int converted to float, array-wrapped int converted to float, array-wrapped float, missing-name failure, and unchanged output on failure.
owner_data_evidence: Source owner candidate: 0x48cfb0 is a zReader namespace lookup helper over typed Node/Value records and the address-backed zReader_GetNamedNode dependency.
Data gate candidate: 0x48cfb0 touches no authored globals; it only reads caller-owned zReader::Node trees and writes caller-owned outValue.
